Article Title: Edmonton Oilers captain Connor McDavid renews BetMGM Partnership amid concerns over gambling advertising
Article Text:
Connor McDavid (Credit: Getty Images)

Connor McDavid will promote gambling on BetMGM in Ontario under the so-called “responsible gambling” messaging

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Edmonton Oilers captain Connor McDavid has reportedly renewed his partnership with BetMGM amid concerns over gambling advertising. This extension of the partnership could draw sharp criticism from gambling-harm advocates over the influence of betting-related messaging on sports fans.The multiyear agreement, announced on October 15, will see the NHL superstar continue to appear in the company's responsible gambling campaigns across broadcast, digital, and social media platforms. According to reports, McDavid will continue to promote gambling on BetMGM in Ontario under the so-called “responsible gambling” messaging, a widely discredited framework for dealing with the public health consequences of commercialized sports gambling.As Edmonton Oilers captain Connor McDavid has extended his partnership with BetMGM, it has come to light that he will continue to promote gambling on BetMGM in Ontario under the so-called “responsible gambling” messaging. It is a widely discredited framework for dealing with the public health consequences of commercialized sports gambling. The World Health Organization is among the groups that have called the framework ineffective.However, the Canadian Medical Experts have criticized the same, stating in one of their study, “Recognizing that youth are particularly vulnerable to the messaging of betting as an augmentation of spectatorship, in 2024 the Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario banned online gambling ads that feature athletes and celebrities.However, within days, commercials with celebrity athletes promoting ‘responsible gaming’ features of sports betting platforms were released to sidestep the ban.The study also added, "Warnings to game responsibly have, however, been shown in a systematic review of 166 studies to be ineffective, which highlights the weak efforts of provincial governments who stand to make substantial revenue from iGaming (Ontario’s open single-game industry produced a total tax revenue of more than $1.4 billion during its first 3 years).”As per reports, McDavid first joined BetMGM's roster of ambassadors in March 2022. Under the renewed agreement, he will continue promoting the company's player-protection tools, including deposit limits, stake limits, time-out features, and self-exclusion options, available through the BetMGM app. The company also plans to expand the campaign to new audiences and markets.Meanwhile, BetMGM CEO Adam Greenblatt praised McDavid's involvement, saying the partnership had helped make responsible gambling messaging engaging and encouraged customers to use player-protection tools.He added, “The results of our campaign reflect how thoughtful messaging can drive meaningful action, with more players using tools like deposit limits to play within their comfort level. We’re proud to continue working with one of hockey’s most respected leaders to ensure that gaming is always fun and entertaining.”McDavid also highlighted the importance of discipline and decision-making, drawing a comparison between hockey and sports betting. “Being disciplined and making smart decisions are big parts of hockey. They're important when it comes to sports betting, too,” McDavid said.The renewed agreement comes as sports betting companies continue to promote player-protection measures while facing broader scrutiny over the effects of gambling advertising on consumers, particularly.
Article Summary: Connor McDavid will continue to promote gambling on BetMGM in Ontario under the so-called “responsible gambling” messaging. The World Health Organization is among the groups that have called the framework ineffective. This extension of the partnership could draw sharp criticism from gambling-harm advocates over the influence of betting-related messaging.

Article Title: How to download Minecraft Bedrock 26.70.21 beta and preview

Minecraft 26.70.21 beta and preview has been released (Image via Mojang)

Steps to download Minecraft Bedrock 26.70.21 beta and preview

Windows 10/11 (PC)

Open the Minecraft Launcher on your PC.

Select Minecraft: Bedrock Edition from the left-hand sidebar.

Select the drop-down menu next to the Play button and choose “Latest Preview.”

The launcher will download Minecraft build 26.70.21.

Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S

Go to the Xbox Game Store or Game Pass Library on your Xbox console.

Search for and locate “Minecraft Preview.”

Tap the “Install” button to download and install the preview build on your Xbox.

PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5

Find Minecraft on your PlayStation homepage or within the game library.

Head to the left sidebar and scroll down to find the Preview option.

Click on “Get PlayStation 4/5 Preview” and use the download option to install it.

Pocket Edition (Android and iOS)

Android (Google Play Store)

Open the Google Play Store app and search for Minecraft.

Scroll down on the game's store page to find the Beta Program section.

Tap "Join" to enroll and become eligible to download the beta version.

iOS (Apple App Store)

The Minecraft 26.70.21 preview is available on iOS devices via the TestFlight app.

Sign up through the official Minecraft TestFlight link.

You will receive an email providing you with the link to download the beta. Keep in mind that the iOS beta is usually full.

What’s new in Minecraft 26.70.21 beta and preview

Packed Ice Bricks

& Frozen Biomes

Building a winter fortress just got a massive upgrade. The update introduces Packed Ice Bricks, a brand-new blue-tinted decorative block set that includes slabs, stairs, walls, and chiseled variants. Ice Caves have also become more treacherous; Crevasses now generate with greater consistency, and players can fall into hidden caves if the Brittle Ice beneath them breaks.

Music Features Add-On

Minecraft Bedrock 26.70.21 beta and preview is officially out and along with it comes a cool set of Drop 4 features for players to test. This update is all about growing the frozen biomes and introducing new decorative ice blocks, plus an amazing built-in Music Features Add-On that lets you take your favorite tunes on-the-go.As always, be aware that these work in progress versions can be unstable and might not be representative of the final release quality. If you want to test these new mechanics before they hit the stable build, you can download the preview and provide your feedback.The Minecraft Bedrock 26.70.21 beta and preview is now available for download on PC, Xbox, PlayStation, and mobile. The Minecraft Preview is available for Xbox, PlayStation, Windows and iOS devices, while the beta is available for Android.Here are the instructions that you can follow to download it:Listed below are some of the key features from the Minecraft 26.70.21 beta and preview:This was all you needed to know about Minecraft 26.70.21 beta and preview.

Cupra Kiro new car

CUPRA Raval gets a sporty new look

CUPRA KIRO reveals new Formula E car for 2026/27

Article Title: Jaguar unveils Type 01 electric car with 1,030PS power and 450-mile range

Jaguar Type 01

A modern cabin with new technology

What does the Type 01 name mean?

Jaguar on Friday unveiled the Type 01, an all-electric luxury car that marks a new beginning for the British carmaker. It can go from 0 to 62 mph in just 3.2 seconds. It has three electric motors that produce 1,030PS of power and 1,365Nm of torque.The Type 01 is Jaguar's new flagship electric car. Its range is up to 450 miles (720km) under WLTP testing.The car uses an 850-volt electrical system that supports fast charging. Article Title: Formula E names COMSOL its Official Multiphysics Partner in new multi-year deal
Article Text:
Formula E and Comsol

Formula E joins hands with COMSOL to boost electric racing technology

AI and digital twins also in focus

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

GEN4 to bring bigger technology demands

Formula E on Thursday announced a new multi-year partnership with COMSOL, which will become the Official Multiphysics Partner of the ABB FIA Formula E World Championship. The partnership brings together Formula E, the world's leading all-electric motorsport championship, and COMSOL, a company known for its multiphysics simulation and computer-aided engineering software. As part of the partnership, Formula E and COMSOL engineers will use COMSOL Multiphysics to study complex engineering problems involving several physical systems working together.Electric race cars depend on several systems at the same time. These include electrical, thermal, structural, electromagnetic, fluid and battery systems.All these systems have to work together under tough performance and energy limits. COMSOL will provide Formula E's technology teams with simulation software and technical expertise to help them understand how these different physical effects interact.ID@undefined Caption not available.The partnership will also look at simulation apps and digital twin technology. The aim is to make engineering information easier to use outside the traditional modelling process.Bjorn Sjodin, SVP of Product Management at COMSOL, said, “Formula E is a great example of why multiphysics simulation matters, as multiple phenomena are at play and constantly interact with one another.We are excited to work directly with Formula E's technology team and put COMSOL Multiphysics to work on these kinds of real-world challenges.”Formula E CTO Dan Cherowbrier said the partnership will strengthen the championship's engineering capabilities.“Technology is at the heart of Formula E, so partnering with COMSOL makes real sense for us and truly enhances our engineering skillsets. COMSOL gives us a powerful environment for understanding complex systems where many different physical effects are connected, but the opportunity goes beyond individual simulations.
